description: Approved differences observable in the documents this host serves rather than in a data-plane response. Each is executed by fetching a served document and reading exact JSON pointers out of it; a pointer whose recorded value is null must be absent from the document.

cases.note: The recorded values are what the authoritative Ed-Fi fixture publishes: limit defaults to 25 with a maximum of 500, and pageSize defaults to 25 with no maximum. DMS replaces both with the runtime MaximumPageSize, so the published metadata tracks the deployment rather than a hardcoded pair. ODS's runtime maximum for both parameters is likewise a configurable setting already defaulting to 500, so this difference is confined to published metadata rather than runtime enforcement.

Ed-Fi's published metadata omits the numberOfPartitions default entirely, which is what the null records. ODS's default partition count is likewise a configurable setting defaulting to 10, so DMS matches ODS runtime behavior here and differs only in the published metadata.

ODS 7.3.2's paths factory keeps every resource that is readable or writable and then adds the partition path for each non-composite resource through a path method that carries no Readable guard, unlike the sibling collection and by-id path methods, which gate their read operations on it. Every observation but the last is identical on both sides, so the difference is exactly the sibling path's presence.
